_sources.crossover_rate: Koza tutorial, p. 2: crossover on about 90% of the population
_sources.mutation_rate: Koza tutorial, p. 2: mutation on about 1% of the population; reproduction takes the rest (tutorial: about 8%)
_sources.depth_limit: Luke & Panait 2006, Sec. 3 (p. 6): children deeper than 17 replaced by a copy of their parent
_sources.tournament_size: Luke & Panait 2006, Sec. 3 (p. 6): tournament selection of size 7
_sources.complexity_weight: Luke & Panait 2006, Sec. 5 (p. 10): linear parametric parsimony pressure; tuned per dataset
